source: Evans-Soma et al. (2025), Nature Astronomy 9, 845, 'SiO and a super-stellar C/O ratio in the atmosphere of the giant exoplanet WASP-121b' (doi:10.1038/s41550-025-02513-x; arXiv:2506.01771). JWST NIRSpec G395H phase curve of program 1729 (37.8 h, two eclipses and a transit). Map values from Supplementary Table 1 (white phase-curve fit results), best-fit column, read from the arXiv version's supplementary information; the deposited products are Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.20651891 (CC BY 4.0).

model.description: starry, a degree-1 spherical-harmonic map for the planet and a quadratic limb-darkening law for the star (Methods, 'White phase-curve fitting'). The fitted map terms are the planet-to-star luminosity A, the Y(1,0) coefficient and the phase offset; a map with Y(1,0) alone was favoured by the BIC over maps adding Y(1,1) and Y(2,0), so Y(1,-1) and Y(1,1) are zero.

y.where: Methods: Y(1,0) alone favoured by the BIC

conversion.description: The authors' phase-binned planet-to-star spectra and brightness temperatures give each channel's conversion term; the star's mean detected counts in each channel, from the deposited 1D spectra of this detector, weight the channels as the white light curve sums them.
